messages.subject: AIS | Digital society, partnerships and institutional strategy
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Leelapanang and AIS Leadership Team,

AIS's mission to lead a sustainable Thai digital society through ecosystems and partnerships closely matches the kind of institutional coordination I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy.

I manage multi-agency engagement, formal regulatory workflows and strategic partnerships across a heavily regulated environment. I also bring sustainability, energy-transition and carbon-governance experience. This combination would support digital infrastructure growth where public policy, community impact and commercial priorities intersect.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional mandates across Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or Country Strategy. I have attached an AIS-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
